drafts.draft_en:
It's almost incomprehensible how wide the gap is right now between brands that check every AI ad before it ships and everyone else.

And the lines aren't converging.

One group ships 10x more variants with fewer mistakes. The other ships 10x more variants and finds out from the takedown notice.
drafts.video_tip: 12s vertical. Simple chart animates two lines from the same start point: one labeled 'checked before publish' climbing cleanly, one labeled 'hope nobody notices' climbing then dropping with red takedown icons. Read the first line to camera over it. End on 'the lines aren't converging.'

drafts.draft_en:
Manual ad review is dead.

AI now makes creative faster than any brand, legal, or policy team can read it.

I'll show you what replaces the review queue in 3 minutes.
drafts.video_tip: 3-min talking head with screen inserts. 0-20s: the review queue problem (a pile of AI variants waiting on one reviewer). 20s-2:30: one ad going through brand, legal-claim, and platform-policy checks and coming back APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK. Last 30s: what the team does with the time back. Burn the '3 minutes' promise into the thumbnail.

drafts.draft_en:
The future of advertising is agents checking other agents' work.

One agent makes the ad. Another checks it against your brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy before a dollar of media gets spent.

Put in your AGENTS.md: never publish creative that hasn't passed a brand check.
drafts.video_tip: 15s screen capture. Show an AGENTS.md file, type the last line live, then cut to a creative agent handing an ad to a verification agent that stamps it FIX with a one-line reason. Hold on the AGENTS.md line as the final frame.
